common: Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE independent frame of original Ling Yue combat sprite. Reference 1 locks E camera/framing/anatomy, reference 2 original fox identity, reference 3 main confirmed painterly style/material (never UI). Exactly FOUR fox legs and NINE separate white-lavender long fluffy tails, gold eyes, cinnabar forehead, red-inner pointed ears, gold/jade collar and round jade pendant. True 3/4 FRONT facing diagonally lower RIGHT. Same refined clean bright hand-painted fur volume and proportions. Match reference1 square canvas registration, body scale, tail root, grounded paw positions. Genuine transparent RGBA, no ground/shadow, text, panels, environment or camera change. Keep all nine tail tips distinct and inside canvas. No auto-fitting, no global translation, only articulated pose. Native square target1024; fixed export transform applies later.

hit: Alert moment immediately before impact: head lowered slightly, ears attentive, four paws stable, knees soft, chest poised and tails tense.
Impact from lower right begins: neck pulls back, head dips, ears angle back, shoulders and all four knees flex to lower chest. Same paws grounded, tails lag forward.

Deepest impact recoil: eyes squint, ears flatten, neck recoils, spine arches softly, all legs flex clearly while staying grounded; nine tail tips bend forward with inertia. No whole-body displacement.
Recovery from deepest recoil: spine unbends, head lifts halfway, ears still back, forelegs partly straighten with same ground contacts. Nine tails pass recoil apex.
Recovery settles: nearly upright torso and starting head direction, eyes open, knees still lightly bent, collar pendant swings gently forward, tail fan relaxes.
Final stable alert recovery: upright ears, forward gaze, chest almost neutral with slight remaining knee flex; four support paws fixed, nine tails settling. New settling pose, not a duplicate.
attack: Alert preparation, subtle head-down and shoulder tension, all four paws support, nine tails softly fanned.
Four legs flex to lower weight, neck reaches slightly lower right; anatomical RIGHT FOREPAW unloads. Other three paws support.
Lift anatomical RIGHT front paw (near/frontmost forepaw in E view), elbow folds under chest. Left front and both hind paws fixed. Nine tails counterbalance.
Right front paw fully chambered at lower chest, elbow back and shoulder slightly pulled back. Other three paws support unchanged.
Swipe begins: RIGHT shoulder reaches forward, elbow opens halfway, paw sweeps lower right above ground. Head follows, three paws fixed.
Fast RIGHT forepaw swipe lower right: elbow mostly extends, fox toes spread modestly, torso twists slightly above three grounded support paws; tail ends lag.
Peak extension/contact: RIGHT forepaw fully forward and lower right, claws modestly spread, same three supports fixed, no leap/weapon/extra leg.
Swipe followthrough: right forepaw arcs slightly downward and inward, wrist curls anatomically, shoulder brakes; tails follow inertia.
Retract RIGHT striking forepaw to chest by folding elbow, shoulder relaxes, body faces original direction, three supports stay fixed.
Right front paw descends toward ORIGINAL support location, toes almost touch; hind knees straighten, never step ahead.
Right front paw touches down, four feet support, knees still soft and jade pendant settles, tails ease into original fan.
Final stable alert recovery: all four original support contacts maintained, head focuses lower right, chest neutral, subtle tail settling. Unique freshly drawn final pose.
